summary: In Kharanos, Ozzie Togglevolt sends adventurers toward Gnomeregan to gather radioactive fallout. He hopes to make a cure for the leper gnomes, though the brew may become potent drink.

sections.title: A Cure or a Cocktail
sections.body: Since Gnomeregan fell, refugees such as Gnoarn have sought to kill the trogg invaders and reverse the sickness that changed their kin. Ozzie Togglevolt and his partner Razzle Sprysprocket have taken another path from their workshop in Kharanos. Ozzie says they are trying to make a cure for the leper gnomes. Their formula might instead become very strong rum.

sections.title: Harvesting the Glow
sections.body: Ozzie and Razzle need toxic residue from the heart of the disaster. Ozzie gives adventurers a leaden collection phial and sends them toward Gnomeregan's breached tunnels. Irradiated Invaders and Irradiated Pillagers roam there, troggs saturated with leaking waste. The phial needs their green glow.

sections.title: Hair and High Hopes
sections.body: With a full phial of green glow, Ozzie prepares a live trial. He hopes the brew will restore the health and sanity of a captured leper gnome. He also hopes the fallout mixture might cure his baldness.

faq.answer: Ozzie Togglevolt, a gnome tinkerer in Kharanos, offers this work.

faq.q: What do I need to collect for this quest?
faq.answer: Use an Empty Leaden Collection Phial on glowing Irradiated Invaders or Irradiated Pillagers to gather radioactive fallout until the phial is full.

faq.q: Where can I find the irradiated troggs?
faq.answer: Find the irradiated troggs in the outer entrance caverns and winding halls leading to Gnomeregan's instance portal. You can reach them without entering the dungeon.

faq.q: Do I have to complete 'The Day After' before taking this quest?
faq.answer: No. Ozzie offers this independently of The Day After, though that story is tied to the situation in Kharanos and leads up to it.

faq.q: What is Ozzie trying to accomplish with the radioactive fallout?
faq.answer: Ozzie and Razzle are trying to make a cure for leper gnomes, though Ozzie admits the brew might become high-proof rum.
A full phial leads to The Only Cure is More Green Glow, which sends you deeper into Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As an exiled gnome, you know how desperate your kin are to find a remedy for their irradiated brethren. Even Ozzie's wild experiments are worth trying.
As an Alliance member, you know Gnomeregan's contamination threatens all of Dun Morogh. Understanding or containing the fallout matters to the region's safety.
As an engineer, you see gnomish field science at work: raw radioactive runoff gathered in shielded leaden phials.
